_note: Measured properties per compound, as compiled by the chemicals library 1.5.2 (Caleb Bell, MIT licence) from the sources listed (first non-estimated source in its order). Tb boiling point K, Tm melting point K, Tf flash point K, Ta autoignition K, LFL/UFL flammability limits (volume fraction in air), Hfg/Hfl/Hfs heat of formation of gas/liquid/solid kJ/mol; *_s = source index. Single compounds only (no mixtures, salts written as ions, isotopes). vp: vapour pressure (Pa, T in K): ["p", C1..C5, Tmin, Tmax] ln P = C1 + C2/T + C3 ln T + C4 T^C5 (Perry's Handbook 8th ed., DIPPR 101); ["a10", A, B, C, Tmin, Tmax] log10 P = A − B/(T + C) (Poling, Prausnitz & O'Connell, Properties of Gases and Liquids 5th ed.); ["ae", A, B, C, Tmin, Tmax] ln P = A − B/(T + C) (Landolt-Börnstein), as tabulated in the chemicals library.
